text:
Hi everyone,
my partner and I are  going through the process in the ministry of interior .Right now I’m on A5 visa for one year, before spend 3 years on B/1 visa.

We are planning to have a child and also considering adoption in the future. Our concern is that until  I’ll have permanent residency , the child will not have the same secure status here.

Has anyone in a similar situation managed to shorten or speed up the process of getting  permanent residency for a non‑Israeli same‑sex partner?
